request.sql:
SELECT
    sum(l_extendedprice * l_discount) AS revenue
FROM
    lineitem
WHERE
    l_shipdate >= CAST('1994-01-01' AS date)
    AND l_shipdate < CAST('1995-01-01' AS date)
    AND l_discount BETWEEN 0.05
    AND 0.07
    AND l_quantity < 24;

result.optimized_plan:
Project: [revenue AS revenue]
  Aggregate: group_by=[], aggs=[SUM((l_extendedprice * l_discount))]
    Project: [lineitem.l_extendedprice, lineitem.l_discount]
      Scan: lineitem [l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax, l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipinstruct, l_shipmode, l_comment]
        projection: [4, 5, 6, 10]
        filter: ((((l_shipdate >= DATE(8766)) AND (l_shipdate < DATE(9131))) AND l_discount BETWEEN 0.05 AND 0.07) AND (l_quantity < 24))
